messages:
Maya Chen: Kicking off a surgical wedge for the router traffic shift — moving a cohort to the green pool (g11) for release-2.14.3. Change window 21:00-22:00 UTC. Target ramp 8% -> 20% over 15m. Pinning version on the cohort. @Dom please confirm DB proxy warm.
Dom Patel: Ack. DB proxies warmed in shadow, no errors. I'll hold at 8% for first 5m and watch p95 + 5xx.
deploy-bot: [deploy-event] wedge-started id=wedg-1704056782 actor=Maya Chen pools=(green,gold) target_weights=(8%,92%) version=release-2.14.3
Harry Lopez: Preflight metrics (21:01 UTC): p95=120ms, p50=20ms, total_errors=0.21%. Canary policy: steady 10m before further ramp.
Maya Chen: Plan and rollback gates: - Checkpoints at 5m, 10m, 25m. - Abort/reroute if 5xx delta > +1.0% absolute OR p95 > 200ms for >3m. - Manual hold allowed.
Dom Patel: Router pin command I'm about to run (local test):
```
# pin green pool to release
routectl set-pool-version --pool g11 --version release-2.14.3
routectl set-weight --pool g11 --weight 8
```
I'll push the same via deploy-bot once we confirm.
ops-bot: applied weights: g11=8% at 21:03:10 UTC
Harry Lopez: Small latency uptick 21:05 -> p95=140ms, errors unchanged 0.23%.
Maya Chen: Ramp to 12% at checkpoint 2 if no error gate hit. Dom, when you ramp please emit the post-change note in this thread.
ops-bot: ramp applied: g11=12% at 21:08:45 UTC
Dom Patel: Noted a single 502 burst between 21:09:30-21:09:40 (~30s). Investigating backend timeouts. Spike = 0.08% so far.
Maya Chen: Keep an eye. If 5xx exceeds 1.5% we roll back immediately. @SRE Oncall prep rollback commands and logs snapshot.
SRE Oncall: Ready. Rollback commands queued and verified: `routectl set-weight --pool g11 --weight 0` then `routectl pin-version --service router --version release-2.14.2`. Have runbooks open and log links.
deploy-bot: canary-monitor: p95=150ms, errors=0.35% (21:12 UTC), trace-sample links: https://observe/redwood/traces/wedg-1704056782
Maya Chen: Continue ramp to 20% if no gate in next 8m. Finalization plan: if stable for 10m at 20% we'll flip remaining traffic and mark release promoted.
Dom Patel: DB replica lag stable, no new errors on write path.
Harry Lopez: Running perf checklist and watching alpha traces for tail latencies. Will signal here if anything looks suspicious.
ops-bot: ramp applied: g11=20% at 21:20:05 UTC
Maya Chen: Green at 20% and holding for 10m. Release notes snippet for PM/Support:
- release-2.14.3: router routing & KV-cache backpressure fixes
- rollout: staged wedge 8->20% 21:00-21:25 UTC
- two safety gates: 5xx spike >1.0% OR p95>200ms -> rollback
Dom Patel: All good from infra side. No config drift.
Harry Lopez: p95 steady 155ms, errors 0.4% after ramp (within expected). Will start final validation suite at 21:28.
Maya Chen: If everything stays healthy at 21:35 we finalize and update prod tag. TL;DR: wedge succeeded so far, rollback plan ready, keep watches on 5xx and p95. :thumbsup:
